title: A message priced by the word
text: The telegraph office will transmit a family message, but each extra word costs money. You need to explain something delicate.

choices.label: Choose the essential words

outcomes.text: A carefully shortened message reached its destination intact.
The recipient misunderstood the one detail I had cut.

choices.label: Send a longer letter

outcomes.text: My letter arrived with enough context to be understood.
By the time the letter arrived, the decision had already been made.

choices.label: Wait for someone travelling there

outcomes.text: A traveller delivered it in person and brought news back.
The traveller changed their route; the message stayed in a coat pocket.

title: The station that might change the town
text: A proposed railway promises work and easier journeys. Its route would cut through a neighbour’s land.

choices.label: Listen to the affected households

outcomes.text: The meeting produced a safer crossing and an amended route.
The company heard us out, then laid the original route anyway.

choices.label: Ask about the new work

outcomes.text: I learned what the job involved before making promises.
The promised work was shorter and harder than the notice suggested.

choices.label: Keep clear of the argument

outcomes.text: I kept my routine while the town changed around me.
I discovered too late that my own route had disappeared.

title: The water everyone shares
text: Several households fall ill after drawing from the same street pump. Certainty is scarce; the queue still forms.

choices.label: Seek another water source

outcomes.text: We carried clean water farther and helped a frail neighbour.
The extra journey exhausted us and did not answer every question.

choices.label: Tell the local physician what I noticed

outcomes.text: My account gave the physician a pattern worth investigating.
The physician dismissed the pattern; I still had to choose where to drink.

choices.label: Follow the ordinary routine

outcomes.text: Nothing happened to me, though the worry stayed.
I fell ill and regretted treating familiarity as evidence.

title: A room listening together
text: A neighbour has assembled a wireless set. The signal fades just as the evening programme begins.

choices.label: Help adjust the aerial

outcomes.text: A clearer signal turned the room into a small shared celebration.
We chased interference through the whole evening.

choices.label: Bring a story of my own

outcomes.text: When the signal faded, my story kept the room listening.
My story met polite silence and a request to try the dial again.

choices.label: Listen from the doorway

outcomes.text: I enjoyed the programme without taking over the gathering.
The crowded doorway made me feel more outside than I expected.

title: A motorcar on a narrow street
text: A motorcar breaks down where carts and pedestrians need to pass. Its owner is embarrassed and impatient.

choices.label: Help push it clear

outcomes.text: We freed the street before anybody had to raise their voice.
Moving it took more effort than the owner admitted.

choices.label: Fetch someone who repairs engines

outcomes.text: A mechanic found the fault and taught me what to look for.
The mechanic could not get a replacement part that week.

choices.label: Wait for the street to clear

outcomes.text: The delay became a conversation with someone I had never met.
I missed the appointment I thought could wait.

title: The music through the hall door
text: A local dance hall has a new band. A friend wants company, though tomorrow’s work starts early.

choices.label: Go and leave at a sensible hour

outcomes.text: We caught the best set and still made the morning.
One more tune became a very short night.

choices.label: Find a quieter table

outcomes.text: I heard the music and a friend’s news without shouting.
Every table was full; the quiet plan lasted minutes.

choices.label: Invite them another evening

outcomes.text: We made a plan neither of us had to rush.
They went without me, and our next plan never quite happened.

title: A recording nobody labelled
text: A friend lends you a cassette with a handwritten track list. One song sounds like somebody from your town.

choices.label: Find out who made it

outcomes.text: I found a local musician and a reason to attend their next show.
The trail ended at another unlabelled copy.

choices.label: Make a copy to share

outcomes.text: A carefully made copy started a new conversation between friends.
The tape tangled halfway through the song everyone wanted.

choices.label: Return it with a note

outcomes.text: My note mattered more to my friend than I expected.
I returned it before listening to the last side.

title: The queue at the fuel station
text: A supply interruption has made fuel uncertain. People trade rumours while the queue barely moves.

choices.label: Arrange a shared journey

outcomes.text: We used less fuel and discovered a route that worked.
The shared timetable clashed with everyone’s shifts.

choices.label: Ask for reliable information

outcomes.text: The station gave me a realistic time to return.
The delivery was delayed again after I had rearranged the day.

choices.label: Keep my usual journey

outcomes.text: I arrived on time because the queue finally moved.
I spent the morning waiting and still left without enough fuel.

title: Coins for one more call
text: You need to reach someone from a public telephone. Your change will not buy a long conversation.

choices.label: Explain the important part first

outcomes.text: They understood what mattered before the coins ran out.
The line cut off before I heard their answer.

choices.label: Ask someone nearby for change

outcomes.text: A small kindness bought enough time to sort things out.
Nobody had the right coins, and the shop was closing.

choices.label: Arrange to meet in person

outcomes.text: The conversation was easier when we could see each other.
I waited at the wrong entrance with no easy way to call.

title: A coast missing from the chart
text: The lookout sees rocks where the chart promises deep water. The tide is turning.

choices.label: Heave to and sound the water

outcomes.text: A patient approach saved the hull and corrected our chart.
The delay let another ship reach the anchorage first.

choices.label: Trust the lookout and change course

outcomes.text: We cleared the reef and the lookout earned the crew’s trust.
The safer course led into weather nobody had seen.

choices.label: Follow the chart

outcomes.text: We found a narrow passage and came through.
The keel struck; repairs consumed the next voyage’s time.

title: The seal that will not stay quiet
text: A habitat air sensor keeps reporting a slow leak. The patch held yesterday; it has not held tonight.

choices.label: Isolate the section and check every seal

outcomes.text: We found the damaged gasket before the reserve became critical.
The search used up a shift and delayed essential maintenance elsewhere.

choices.label: Ask another shift for a second diagnosis

outcomes.text: A fresh pair of eyes found the fault our routine had missed.
The second diagnosis contradicted the first; we had to test both.

choices.label: Keep watch and wait for morning

outcomes.text: The readings stabilised and we repaired it in daylight.
The alarm worsened during the night and nobody slept.

title: The petition beyond the gates
text: A household affected by an official decision asks to be heard. Advisers prefer a ceremonial answer.

choices.label: Hear the household’s account

outcomes.text: A specific injustice became harder for the court to ignore.
My interest raised expectations I could not fulfil alone.

choices.label: Ask for an independent review

outcomes.text: The review found a practical correction without making a spectacle.
The review took months while the household kept waiting.

choices.label: Send the customary response

outcomes.text: The ceremony was orderly and the household felt acknowledged.
The polished response answered nothing they had asked.

title: The person who keeps the curtains closed
text: Someone who knows your secret has begun ageing. They worry about who will protect it after them.

choices.label: Make a careful succession plan

outcomes.text: We found a trusted person and recorded the rules together.
Trust could not be transferred as neatly as the papers.

choices.label: Let them decide who to tell

outcomes.text: Their choice gave the next keeper a reason to care.
They chose someone who needed more convincing than either of us expected.

choices.label: Keep the burden to myself

outcomes.text: They slept easier after handing the secret back.
Their absence left a practical gap I had refused to plan for.

title: A remedy with a living ingredient
text: The ingredient you need grows in a neighbour’s neglected garden. Harvesting it would make the next spell easier.

choices.label: Ask and share what I make

outcomes.text: The neighbour agreed and a careful remedy helped us both.
They asked a question my explanation could not safely answer.

choices.label: Grow my own and wait

outcomes.text: The slower answer left me with a dependable supply.
The first seedlings failed and the spell had to wait.

choices.label: Look for a substitute

outcomes.text: An ordinary ingredient worked better than I expected.
The substitute changed the spell in a way I had not planned.

title: A rescue that exposes the ordinary life
text: A witness recognises something about your civilian identity during a rescue. They ask to speak privately.

choices.label: Talk honestly within safe limits

outcomes.text: They protected the secret and understood why it mattered.
They wanted guarantees I could not honestly give.

choices.label: Ask them to focus on the people rescued

outcomes.text: The story they told gave the survivors the attention.
A small identifying detail still made it into the account.

choices.label: Disappear before they can ask again

outcomes.text: The unanswered question faded while another story took over.
My abrupt departure made the witness more curious.

title: A record that says you are gone
text: A clerk finds your death record while checking an ordinary form. You are standing at the counter.

choices.label: Explain what I can calmly

outcomes.text: The clerk found a way to handle the form without announcing me.
The explanation attracted a supervisor and a locked office.

choices.label: Bring someone who remembers me

outcomes.text: A familiar witness gave my impossible story a human anchor.
The witness was more frightened than I had realised.

choices.label: Leave the paperwork for another day

outcomes.text: I found another way to manage the immediate problem.
The unresolved record followed me into the next task.

title: The continuity mistake
text: A scene has been filmed with a detail that contradicts the next one. Reshooting costs time.

choices.label: Discuss it with the script supervisor

outcomes.text: The slower decision exposed something the easy answer had missed. I earned trust by explaining the work.
The extra check was necessary, but the delay still had consequences.

choices.label: Ask a colleague to challenge my assumptions

outcomes.text: A colleague noticed the detail I had stopped seeing. The plan became more workable.
We disagreed about the priority and had to start again.

choices.label: Carry on with the existing plan

outcomes.text: The familiar plan held together this time.
The ignored detail returned as a problem I could no longer delegate.
